# BAD-054 — Split admin/src/app/accounts/[email]/page.tsx (1207 lines) into _lib/ and _components/

## Brief
Plan: [[docs/spikes/bad-036/admin-account-page|admin-account-page spike]] (Charlotte, BADS-036).

Proposed: page.tsx keeps its default export, its dynamic export and all data fetching; everything else moves to _lib/ and _components/ beside it, and the 488-line UserTab becomes 10 components. No file over 250. next build rejects any page export outside the allowed names, which is why nothing else stays exported from page.tsx.

The load-bearing rule: sub-components never fetch data. Rendering several fetching components concurrently exhausts the admin's three-connection pool and brings back the page hang that the current single-fetch shape fixed.

Verification: the admin's lint, typecheck and build, the export diff, and a render diff of the account page against the local stack before and after, per the spike's section 8.

**Gate.** Queued until Eric approves the proposed file layout in the spike. Phase 2 does not start before that approval, and an approval that changes the layout is written into the spike's section 4 first.

**Rules for Phase 2, from BAD-036.** Split by responsibility; 250 lines is where a file gets a second look, not a cap, and every file left over 250 is argued in the spike's section 6. Every PR is a pure move: no statement is edited, a bug found on the way is its own ticket, and the spike's behaviour-preservation check (section 8) runs on every PR. The public surface in section 2 is the compatibility contract and does not change. Extraction order follows section 9: shared constants, types and pure utilities first, then state and services, then sub-components or handlers, then the entry file reduced to an orchestrator. Verification is the implementing-changes skill's tier for the files touched, quoted in each PR.

## Size, persona and model decision
Phase 2: one engineer on opus per PR in the spike's section 9, in a worktree on a feat/bad-nnn branch after bash scripts/worktree-init.sh; a reviewer at fable tier (opus while the Fable limit holds) checks each PR's pure-move proof before it lands.

Layout approved as proposed (Eric, 2026-09-15): the spike's section 4 tree stands unchanged — page.tsx keeps the default export, dynamic, TABS, Tab, isTab and every fetch; _lib/ takes usage-rail.ts, flags-or-null.ts and stubs.ts; _components/ takes the nine component files; the ten new components come out of UserTab's 488 lines; no file over 250. Gate cleared, Phase 2 starts.

## Outcome
Done. PR 1 landed as d79a086 (#371), PR 2 as db9f17a (#373, merged by Eric after the classifier refused Spud's own attempt).

admin/src/app/accounts/[email]/page.tsx is 154 lines, was 1207: three _lib/ modules and nine _components/ files beside it, nothing over 195 lines, all twenty original top-level declarations placed exactly once. Both PRs proved from a pre-split baseline and re-proved by a second agent from its own.

What the work taught, beyond the code: the plan's render diff — PR 2's nominated proof — false-failed on every run and could not see a dropped key at all. Both fixed under BAD-074 before PR 2 started, and confirmed from the other side afterwards: dropping a key changed not one byte of 72 documents, while a wrong-side guard lit up eight tabs. The claimed-handle branch, dark through both PRs, was reached once by hand and found identical.

Four follow-ups filed: BAD-071, BAD-076, BAD-077, and SPD-086 for the deliverable glob that matched none of the files this ticket owned.
